rationale.elig-residency: Eligibility §3.2 says 'Applicants must be an Australian citizen or have permanent residency status.'; p.3 records citizenship and Darwin residence.
rationale.elig-property: Eligibility §3.1.1 says 'applicants and tenants who own or partly own residential property anywhere in Australia are ineligible for social housing.'; p.4 declares no interest.
rationale.elig-income: Identification and Documentation §3.2 says 'The CEO (Housing) requires evidence of income and assets to determine eligibility for social housing, private rental bond assistance, and to calculate rent.'; p.5 records the statement received.
rationale.elig-debts: Eligibility §3.4 says 'The provision of social housing will not be withheld based on a debt owed to the CEO (Housing).'; p.7 records no debt.
rationale.elig-former-tenancy: Eligibility §3.5 refers to 'Former social housing tenants'; p.8 finds no former tenancy, so the exclusion does not arise.
rationale.prio-category: Priority §3 lists 'At risk of homelessness;' as urgent need; pp.2 and 9 contain only the applicant's unconfirmed claim, so the category remains undecided.
rationale.prio-documentation: Priority §3.1 says 'Applicants must prove their urgent need for priority housing and are required to provide documentation that supports their claim for priority.'; pp.6 and 10 show the requested support is still absent.
rationale.prio-discretion: Priority §3.1 allows 'some discretion for extreme situations'; pp.2 and 9 provide no extreme-situation basis for a referral.
